content: Pool kañɗiɗ kosiɗ ci ŋ Rom
Ambɗaat to baahiɗ Feebe, ɓitɓi ɓaah ɓoo. A ɓaah ŋ ɓi na taambkohe in ciŋ Janguuniŋ Señsare,
teyɗukaat ɗe baahiɗ ŋ tiikiŋ Heɗi findi ɓo'-Kooh ci na tumohee wa ŋ ɗooƴ ɓa. Tufkohaat ɗe ŋ in nu a etoh nga ɗu ɗah, laam a namiɗ tufkoh ɓo' laayiɗ, po mi sah.
Kañɗiɗaat to Piriska na Akilaas, huntoh ciŋ ngo ŋ pangki ɓoo na pangkiɗe Kiristaani Yeesu.
Ɓeɗ ɓeem, ɓa sangeeɗi sah kaan ne ɓa muciɗ kiñin kiŋ ngo. A mi dong na corkiɗee ɓa haa, Janguuciŋ ɓi nikɗi Yawuut jen ɓa ɗii corkiɗ ɓa.
Namaat to kañɗiɗ ɓooɓi na cohe ŋ Janguuni nik ŋ kahan ɓa. Kañɗiɗaat to Epaynet, nawleeso yi ŋ keeñkoh, a yi koc kos Kiristaani ŋ kur caŋ Asi.
Kañɗiɗaat to Mari, pangki a pangkiɗ ɗu, wa miskiɗ lool.
Kañɗiɗaat to Andoronikos na Juniya, ɓaah ciŋ ngo Yawuut ci taƴsee na so ; ɓa Apootar nawuuɗ, ɓeɗ koc co sah nik ŋ Kiristaani.
Kañɗiɗaat to Ampilyatus, nawleeso yi ŋ keeñkoh ŋ niki ɓoo nik ŋ Heɗi.
Ɗu kañɗiɗ to Irbeŋ, huntohiŋ ɓoo ŋ pangki ɓoo na pangkiɗe Kiristaani, ɗu nam mbo kañɗiɗ Estakis, nawleeso yi ŋ keeñkoh.
Ɗu kañɗiɗ to Apelees, yi teeɓoh ŋoɗi a ŋoɗ ŋ Kiristaani. Ɗu kañɗiɗ to ɓi kahan Aristobil.
Ɗu kañɗiɗ to ɓaah ho Yawuut Herojoon. Ɗu kañɗiɗ to ɓi kahan Narsis ɓi nik ŋ Heɗi.
Kañɗiɗaat to Tirifeen na Tirifoos, ɓa ɓitiɓ ci na pangkiɗe Heɗi panguk miskiɗ. Ɗu kañɗiɗ to Persid, nawleeso yi ŋ keeñkoh, pangki ɓitɓeem na pangkiɗe Heɗi, wa miskootiɗ.
Ɗu kañɗiɗ to Rufus, yeem e Heɗi tan ɗe, kañɗiɗaat to yaay ɓa, a nam nik yaay nga so.
Kañɗiɗaat to Aseŋkirit na Felegon na Hermes na Patrobas na Hermas, na ɓaah ciŋ ɓoo kosiɗ ci nik na ɓa.
Ɗu kañɗiɗ to Filolog na Juliya, na Neere na taambɗoh ce ɓitiɓ, na Olimpas na ɓo'-Kooh ci nik na ɓa jen.
Kañɗohaat ŋ harmban ɗu, ɗu morgiɗkohee, wa hun na keeñ hooliɗ. Janguuciŋ Kiristaani jen ca ɗii kañiɗ ɗu.
Dengoh ci mirndoh
Mi yii ñaah ɗu ɓaah ciŋ ngo, wortukaat ɓi na ɓekee ɗu saɓsukoh, ɓa muuƴɗee ɗu na jangɗoh ci ɗaloh na ci ɗu rahas. Usaat ɓa !
Ɓooɓi mand ɗaa, ɓa na ñaamke Heɗ ɓoo Kiristaani haa, ɓa na ñaamke rook ciŋ ɓa. Ɓa na woye woo neɓiɗ, ɓa woyee in baahiɗ ŋ ɓooɓi po ɓa ñaañoh yunkaaɗiici.
Ɗu nak, ɓooɓi jen inhiɗ kerhiɗi ɗu kerhiɗ Heɗi ; ŋ neɓuuɗ ŋ ini kaɗ nga ɗu, waaye ŋ waaɗiɗ ne ɗu inhisoh ini kaɗ ŋ baahiɗ te ɗu hool ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ baahaaɗi.
Kooh yi na onohe jam hey pooksohe Seytaani maañaaɗi ŋ ooɓ kot ciŋ ɗu. Baahohiŋ Heɗ ɓoo Yeesu nikaat na ɗu.
Askohi
Timoote, huntohiŋ ngo ngaŋ pangki, yii kañiɗ ɗu, a yi na ɓaah ciŋ ngo Yawuut ci Lusiyus, Yasoon na Sosipateer.
Mi yi Tertiyus, yi fiis in ci Pool woo ŋ kaytii jen, mi yii kañiɗ ɗu ŋ tiikiŋ Heɗi.
Gayus yii kañiɗ ɗu. Mi yi Pool, ŋ dal ŋ kahan ce, ɓi Janguuni jen na name coh nga. Erasta, yi na taambkohe raak-raakiŋ kur-taahii, a yii kañiɗ ɗu, a yi na ɓaah ɓoo Kuwartus. [
Kooh, a yi yakɗaah

content.text: Kooh yi min ndengiɗ kosiŋ ɗu !
ŋ ini kaɗ ŋ Yeesu Kiristaa.
Te wa hun na ini teeɓohu,
taamboh ŋ Fiis ciŋ woosuuɗ ci.
ne cuuɓ ci jen min ɗe kerhiɗ
te a yi yakɗaah po faw

footnotes.text: Ngaŋ Fiis ci maañiɗ ci, cum raak ayaanii : "Heɗ ɓoo Yeesu Kiristaa baahohaat ɗu jen ! Amiin !" Waaye Fiis ci uup woor ngaŋ ci maañiɗ ci ris woti raakɗi woo keem.
